text: かわりに　これを　あげよう！

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending on a verb announces what the speaker has decided to do, like 'I shall' or 'let me'. あげよう = 'I'll give it to you'.

patterns.name: 〜かわりに
patterns.explanation: かわりに means 'in place of that', swapping one thing for another. かわりに = 'instead'.
